files.purpose: paper castle base sprite, front view
flattened soldier after a successful fold
opaque cream paper map texture with faint grid
horizontal crease highlight, rotated in code for vertical folds
offline portrait prototype entry point and start/game-over states
responsive 390x844 HUD, panels, safe-area spacing, and touch controls
fixed-step fold-defense prototype with pooled soldiers and sparks
390x844 playing-state HUD mock over a gameplay scene

style: Flat papercraft on warm cream map stock, with slate ink, terracotta fold accents, moss health, restrained shadows, and faint map-grid texture. Chunky paper silhouettes and high-contrast live HUD text stay readable at phone scale.
integration: Open ui/index.html as the offline prototype entry point; it loads only local files.
Keep the art folder beside ui so game.js paths such as ../art/castle.png continue to resolve.
If integrating into another shell, update #score, #combo strong, #folds, #health-text, #health-fill, and #final-score from game state.
Pointer input must begin within 48 canvas pixels of the current sheet edge; a 38-pixel inward drag commits a snapped fold.
Preserve the 390x844 canvas coordinate system and scale the containing #game-shell uniformly for portrait screens.
